body.p: This is an alternative documentation for the Adobe ExtendScript API and the InDesign Object Model. I never liked the representation in the Object Model Viewer of the Adobe ExtendScript Toolkit and therefore used the HTML version by Jongware on a daily basis. However, those files only went up to InDesign CS6 and were not searchable – so I started to convert them on my own. As an intermediate format I chose DITA, which is generated from the original Adobe sources with XSLT. The DITA results were rendered into this WebHelp with the DITA-OT included in oXygen XML Editor. If the structure and layout feel familiar from the Jongware files, that is no coincidence – I am simply used to them.
Feel free to browse the documentation or download a copy for offline usage (unfortunately the offline search does not work in Chrome). The sources of the transformation can be found on GitHub.
The copyright of the original files is held by Adobe Inc.
I am happy to receive feedback and bug reports at gregor@publishingx.de. Keep in mind that the documentation sources are written by Adobe, so I can only correct transformation errors!
This project is based on the fantastic ExtendScript API HTML by Theunis de Jong a.k.a. Jongware († 2020). Without his efforts and inspiration I would not have realized it. Thank you!
